entities.summary: Suman Pokhrel (b. 1967-09-21, Biratnagar) was a political leader or statesperson of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Biratnagar and Nepal. Known in the fields of nepal, journalists & chroniclers, asia.
